# Modern Steps ABA

> Modern Steps ABA provides in-home Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for individuals with autism spectrum disorder and related developmental conditions across Virginia. BCBA-led, evidence-based care delivered in the home, with caregivers as partners in every step.

## Key facts

- No waitlist: families can start now with a free consultation
- Ages: primarily ages 2-16, serving clients up to age 21
- Insurance: accepts most Medicaid and commercial insurances; the team verifies benefits and handles authorizations
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern
- Phone: (571) 866-0640
- Email: mchoudhary@modernstepsaba.com
- Based in: Woodbridge, Virginia (service-area business; all therapy is in-home)

## Services

- In-Home ABA Therapy: personalized, evidence-based treatment plans delivered at home by BCBAs and RBTs
- Early Intervention ABA: early support for young children with autism and developmental delays
- Functional Behavior Assessment (FBA): assessment to understand the function of challenging behaviors and build an effective plan
- Natural Environment Teaching (NET): teaching functional skills in the child's natural everyday settings
- Caregiver Training & Support: coaching so caregivers can reinforce skills between sessions
- Free ABA Consultation: an introductory call to discuss needs and next steps

## How to get started

1. Call (571) 866-0640 or book a free consultation through the website
2. Comprehensive assessment with a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)
3. A personalized treatment plan, then in-home therapy begins - no waitlist

## Service areas (Virginia)

Woodbridge, Manassas, Manassas Park, Lorton, Alexandria, Arlington County, Fairfax County, Springfield, Falls Church, Chantilly, Centreville, Loudoun County, Stafford County, Fredericksburg, Culpeper County, Fauquier County, Prince William County, Richmond, Chesterfield County, Henrico County
